pages.title: Locator search
pages.text: Use this encounter’s locator in the Overworld. It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat.

pages.title: Cue and response
pages.text: When the Golden Hermit King hides in its shell, its native handler cancels incoming attacks and plays a block sound. Stop spending a combo into the closed shell and wait for it to emerge. Leave the nearby area during its attack and retaliate when it is exposed again.

pages.title: Starting combat
pages.text: Waiting for Start on a dedicated server is separate preparation protection. Start combat from the boss encounter menu. In singleplayer use native awakening; server parties and JEM Raid are unavailable there.

pages.title: Next step
pages.text: This victory belongs to the branch for: Ancient Remnant. The other victories in that branch are also required. Sibling prerequisite encounters can be completed in any order.
